verdict.rationale: Status lookup is a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. The pack covers how to file, amend, divide, renew and withdraw applications, and notes that applications are published in the Boletim da Propriedade Industrial. Nothing documents a public page or search tool where an applicant can check the status of their filing or case. Bulletin publication is a related feature, not a status lookup, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
